knob_consumption.explanation: G base=lr; D base=lr*d_lr_mult; learned-noise base=lr; prior base=lr*prior_lr_mult. These then receive role-specific stationarity scale; Atlas auto-feature route multiplies only G/noise ceilings by .25.

All eight declared hosts have a trainable particle prior with its own optimizer group. Explicit common knob applied after provider spec reference, and table rate unaffected by Atlas .25 calibration; row damping/evidence/stationarity can change effective displacement.
Active D base multiplier. Fixed task adaptations currently use1 for images/native and1.5 for the three vector fixtures; not an ineffective knob, but not one of this round shared tuning axes.

Atlas/E22 total_steps=null and lr_control=stationarity: the scheduled cosine branch is not used. PR252 activity logic marks the first three inactive. Horizon cap is not on the finite TUNABLE_FIELDS list.
Numerically owned but not on finite search whitelist; Atlas small-population reference fallback never constructs the feature backend. Tuning these there cannot exercise that backend.
Task-owned; Recipe.make_prior removes it for ParticlePrior. Its serialized reference must not be mistaken for actual cloud standardization.
Not globally ineffective: it is the fallback until the table tester supplies the adaptive serve_average rate. Do not infer inactivity from steady-state adaptive averaging.

Resources/task schedule horizon are delegated task fields in PR252; preset reference values do not override actual host resources. Schedule-free total_steps=null coexists with the unchanged external full update limit.

bounded_next_hypothesis.precondition: Both lower-grid family campaigns have concluded without a study-surviving configuration.
bounded_next_hypothesis.rationale: Empirical acquisition/stability bracket: half-rate/prior1 was late, preset rates acquired early but lost support in a later hold, and .006375/prior2 previously held intensity. These are nonmonotonic measured outcomes; interpolation is a finite strength search, not a proven law or new algorithm.
bounded_next_hypothesis.alternative: d_lr_mult is active and tunable, but the saved evidence has no measured critic-response defect establishing that a critic-balance grid is better justified.
bounded_next_hypothesis.contract: Separate exact-profile declaration and software admission; all8cases, gates, architectures, priors, seeds, serving laws, horizons and original overall paid cap unchanged. No repeated old knob configuration, automatic acquisition extension, seed-only study, ranking or default adoption.
